---
description: Step 1 - Define requirements from the user story
agent: agent
---

Read docs/user-story.md.

1. Act as a requirements analyst. Do NOT write requirements yet.
2. Ask me 5-8 clarifying questions in one batch, covering: scope, inputs (local path vs GitHub URL), supported stacks, error handling, security, performance, and anything ambiguous in the story.
3. Wait for my answers.
4. Then write docs/requirements.md with these sections:
   - Overview
   - Functional requirements (numbered FR-1, FR-2...)
   - Non-functional requirements (NFR-1...)
   - Assumptions and decisions (from my answers)
   - Out of scope
5. Every requirement must be testable. Do not invent facts.
